standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.aggressive: 自适应更冲，收敛可能快也更抖。
optionDescriptions.custom: 不套预设，全听你手填的子参数。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.safe: Adaptation stays on the conservative side.
optionDescriptions.aggressive: Adaptation pushes harder; convergence may be quicker but also shakier.
optionDescriptions.custom: No preset at all -- every sub-parameter comes from what you filled in.

advanced.principle: safe/balanced/aggressive 预设；custom 使用下方手填参数。

advanced_en.principle: safe/balanced/aggressive presets; custom uses the manually filled parameters below.
